integrity: Exact finite 35-vertex incidence computation, independent symbolic elimination in characteristic three, and prime-to-three character quotient argument; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: No classification of nonmaximal configurations or all genus-49 Newton strata. The characteristic-three extremal configuration is geometric; finite-field descent is not asserted. Possible priority under classical projective-geometric terminology has not been eliminated.
title: A rigid seven-point harmonic extremum and its genus-forty-nine Jacobian in characteristic three
